scope: English N5-60 MID; X2 R1, X3 R2

hop2_target: Each task x selection size bin: floor(GE3_count/9), capped by availability

interface: Preserve source REVIEW; supplementary interface REVIEW_SOURCE_INTERFACE_BINDING. No formal interface approval inferred
